subject: Kickoff: codistillation as our large-scale training recipe
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the codistillation productionization. The pitch for the efficiency portfolio: online distillation lets us scale distributed training past the point where synchronous SGD stops paying off — replicas train together and distill from each other's predictions, no parameter-server bottleneck. Our open-source release already ships the Common Crawl paragraph-ID subset (delta-encoded CSVs, ~392MB), so the data story is reproducible from day one.

What I want out of this half: (1) the recipe reproduced on our stack, (2) a wall-clock and cost comparison against our standard data-parallel baseline, (3) a go/no-go on making it the default for models above 10B params. That last one is the Q3 OKR candidate, so evidence needs to land before the 6/26 lock.

Staffing and compute proposal by early April?

Zofia
